_comment: Synthetic VIOLATION (undecidable destination): a presentation whose issued_service_id is blank — the digest names no intended service, so there is no destination fence to diff the egress against and the wrong-vs-intended verdict is undecidable. The check must FAIL with inject-class-issued-digest-destination-undecidable, treating the missing fence as a breach, never a silent pass (kin to the credttl undecidable-TTL verdict).
